approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would change Commonwealth electoral law to increase transparency, reduce financial influence, and level the political playing field.
It would lower the donation disclosure threshold to $1,000 and require real-time disclosure of donations above that threshold within 5 business days.
The bill would also prohibit misleading or deceptive electoral advertising and ban donations from entities that profit from social harm, such as tobacco, gambling, and liquor businesses.
Lowers the donation disclosure threshold from $16,300 to $1,000.
Requires real-time disclosure of donations above $1,000 within 5 business days.
Prohibits misleading or deceptive electoral advertising.
Bans donations from tobacco, gambling, and liquor businesses.
Prohibits donations from substantial Commonwealth government contractors.
Requires union and corporate member approval for donations.
Political parties, candidates, donors, government contractors, unions, corporations, and the Australian Electoral Commission.
